targetContract.rule: Reuse 218 monster runtimeBounds once; do not apply instance scale a second time.

rootMapping.independence: Each projectile uses its own current root and owning player; never a shared primary-player root.
rootMapping.sourceCoordinate: truncate coordinate*20 toward zero, then divide by20; preserve negative values

sampling.equivalence: Not an exact reproduction of AIR rasterization. Source facts and measured native outputs remain separate.
sampling.algorithm: Intersection-local quarter phase lookup of original AIR compiled source fields; accept a sample if any field bit lies inside the target intersection.
sampling.blank: zero-area source frame returns false before sentinel bounds are positioned
nativePrecisionNotModeled: Partial target-edge coverage in some fractional-root draws

sourceOrder: FollowBaseObjectBullet: follow owner only if still alive
lifecycle.attackId: setRole copies the source role attack id; separate ltwj objects need not have distinct owner attack ids
